【Event Details】

Date: Wednesday, November 25, 2026

Meeting time: 10:00 a.m.

Meeting location: West side parking lot of Hanno City Hall

Route: Hanno City Hall → Seiomei District Administrative Center → Shinko Central Park → Sayama PA → Enjo-ji Temple → Hanno City Hall

Distance: Approximately 14 kilometers

Estimated duration: Approximately 4 hours

Participation fee: ¥200 (covers insurance, etc.; collected on the day)

What to bring: Bento lunch, drinks, rain gear, Sugo Aruki handbook (if you have one)

Application deadline: By Saturday, November 21, 2026, to ASA Hanno by phone (042-972-4701) or fax (042-974-2190)

Cancellation notice: Check with ASA Hanno after 9:00 a.m. on the day of the event for any cancellations due to weather or other reasons

Inquiries: Onda (090-2205-8073)

Organizer: Hanno Walking Club

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/10588.html
